steps.caption: Modulation makes parameters move on their own: with an LFO, the music, or a step pattern.
It is set up in the Edit view. Click the gear on deck A's source row.
Each row is one parameter of the source.
VAL is the parameter's own value: what its knob sets.
The other columns are modulation sources: LFO, step sequencer and audio. A cell connects one source to one parameter.
Start with an LFO on Zoom. Click its LFO cell.
The LFO panel opens on the right. A new LFO starts switched off.
Click the power button. The graph shows the wave, and the picture starts to breathe in and out.
The shape buttons pick the wave: sine, triangle, square or random.
Range sets how far it swings. Click the maximum and type a new value.
Time counts in seconds. Beat locks the LFO to the clock, so it moves with the music.
Beat Div sets how many beats one full swing takes.
Back in the grid, the cell's small knob shows the LFO's live value.
Now make Gain flash with the kick drum. Click its AUD cell.
Switch it on. The graph now follows the music.
Frequency Band picks what to listen to. Bass follows the kick drum.
Continuous follows how loud the band is. Transient fires on each new hit.
Response sets how fast it rises and falls. Punchy suits drums.
Range works as for the LFO. From 0 to 40, each kick brightens the picture.
The step sequencer plays a pattern of values. Put one on Lobes.
Switch it on.
Each bar is a step. Click and drag across them to paint a pattern. The outlined bar is the step playing now.
Randomize, Invert, Shift, Copy, Paste, Fill and Euclid build a pattern in one click.
Lobes is on deck A's first knob, so the LOBES knob steps along with the pattern.
Set the clock to BEAT and each step lands on the beat.
Lower Step Hold to make steps slide into each other, and Glide Curve shapes the slide.
The power button mutes a modulator and keeps its settings.
ADD adds the modulator to the value. MUL multiplies the value; SCALE pulls it down as the signal rises.
The knob still sets the starting point. Modulation moves around it.
Every deck, every FX slot and the mixer have the same grid.
Save the preset and its modulation is saved with it.
